proposal.rationale: The previous container logs show nginx [emerg] host not found in upstream "api". The only change to that name is the Service rename in 8733c8d. Reverting the Service name restores DNS resolution without touching the frontend config.
proposal.verify: Service api exists in demo with endpoints. The frontend pod stops restarting, and /api/healthz through the frontend returns 200.

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: api
  namespace: demo
  labels:
    app: api
    app.kubernetes.io/version: "1.0.0"
  annotations:
    repair.example.dev/source-path: deploy/demo/api.yaml
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: api
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: api
        app.kubernetes.io/version: "1.0.0"
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: api
          image: python:3.12-alpine
          command: ["python", "/app/app.py"]
          ports:
            - containerPort: 8000
          env:
            - name: APP_VERSION
              value: "1.0.0"
          envFrom:
            - configMapRef:
                name: api-config
          volumeMounts:
            - name: code
              mountPath: /app
              readOnly: true
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /healthz
              port: 8000
            periodSeconds: 5
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /healthz
              port: 8000
            initialDelaySeconds: 10
            periodSeconds: 10
          resources:
            requests:
              memory: 96Mi
              cpu: 50m
            limits:
              memory: 128Mi
              cpu: 500m
      volumes:
        - name: code
          configMap:
            name: api-code
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: api-svc
  namespace: demo
  labels:
    app: api
    app.kubernetes.io/version: "1.0.0"
  annotations:
    repair.example.dev/source-path: deploy/demo/api.yaml
spec:
  selector:
    app: api
  ports:
    - name: http
      port: 8000
      targetPort: 8000
